extDescription.message: Rejoins text copied from PDFs into proper paragraphs when you paste it into Google Translate, DeepL and other translators.

toastJoined.message: Line breaks joined: $BEFORE$ lines → $AFTER$ paragraphs  (Ctrl+Z to undo, Ctrl+Shift+V to paste as-is)

toastJoinedSingle.message: Line breaks joined: $BEFORE$ lines → 1 paragraph  (Ctrl+Z to undo, Ctrl+Shift+V to paste as-is)

popupToggleTitle.message: Clean automatically when pasting on translator sites

popupAutoHint.message: When enabled, pasting into Google Translate, DeepL, Baidu, Youdao or Bing Translator joins broken lines automatically. Press Ctrl+Shift+V to paste unchanged.
